title: What is an agent with tools?
summary: Orientation. Meet the system you are about to break: planner, executor, three real tools, a RAG store — and the trust boundary that makes all of it exploitable.
takeaway: Security is not 'trust the model'. Assume the planner can be exploited; put guardrails outside the LLM.
design_rule: Defense in depth: DLP → RAG → plan validation → identity → least privilege → HITL → egress.
